rule: both_active: s=min(cP/(1-q),cI/q), with q=0:s=cP and q=1:s=cI; wP=s*(1-q),wI=s*q

inactive_policy.prior_missing_or_disabled: image requires separate single_image_admission; absent admission gives zero
inactive_policy.metadata: missing and disabled remain distinct labels

required_limitations: q must be validated from observations separately; no v38 support-to-q mapping is evaluated
fixed source caps can substantially attenuate valid image supervision at intermediate q
there is no coefficient-independent positive minimum total strength
identical targets can lose total depth strength relative to cP+cI
scalar L1 image preference requires q>0.5; it is not a Gaussian update claim
availability and zero-coefficient policy changes are discrete even though the both-active mapping is continuous
